import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int turnNum = Integer.parseInt(scanner.nextLine().trim());
        int[] aliceChoices = Arrays.stream(scanner.nextLine().split(" "))
                                   .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt)
                                   .toArray();
        int[] bobChoices = Arrays.stream(scanner.nextLine().split(" "))
                                 .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt)
                                 .toArray();

        // Rotate bobChoices by one position to the left
        int firstBobChoice = bobChoices[0];
        for (int i = 0; i < bobChoices.length - 1; i++) {
            bobChoices[i] = bobChoices[i + 1];
        }
        bobChoices[bobChoices.length - 1] = firstBobChoice;

        int minWin = 0;
        int maxWin = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < aliceChoices.length; i++) {
            maxWin += Math.min(aliceChoices[i], bobChoices[i]);
        }

        int max_bob = Arrays.stream(bobChoices).max().getAsInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < bobChoices.length; i++) {
            if (bobChoices[i] == max_bob && bobChoices[i] + aliceChoices[i] > minWin) {
                minWin = bobChoices[i] + aliceChoices[i];
            }
        }

        int max_alice = Arrays.stream(aliceChoices).max().getAsInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < aliceChoices.length; i++) {
            if (aliceChoices[i] == max_alice && aliceChoices[i] + bobChoices[i] > minWin) {
                minWin = aliceChoices[i] + bobChoices[i];
            }
        }

        if (minWin > turnNum) {
            minWin = minWin - turnNum;
        } else {
            minWin = 0;
        }

        System.out.println(minWin + " " + maxWin);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
